Independent hotels lose about two-thirds of their bookings to Booking.com and Expedia.

Not because of bad marketing. Because of commission — 18 to 30% once loyalty programs are counted in, well above what most owners think they're paying.

On a 20-room hotel, that's real money. Six figures a year, by our estimate.

The infrastructure to fix this just got heavily funded — the largest round hospitality software has ever seen landed in January. But funding a booking engine and getting a 20-room independent to actually use it are two different problems.

Monday's episode covers what closes that gap: not a piece of software, but the standing task force that runs it — the audit, the stack, and the pricing model nobody else in this space publishes.

Full breakdown, evidence, and the build plan drop Monday at 11 AM ET.
